i1.title: VGR V-123 Professional Hair Clipper for Men
i1.descriptionHtml:
A clipper that holds its line through a full cut, instead of dragging and pulling halfway through.

Why this one

  • Professional VGR V-123 Design. Stylish and premium-looking hair clipper, suitable for both professional barbers and home grooming.
  • Powerful DC Motor. High-performance motor provides strong and consistent power for smooth cutting without frequent stopping.
  • Professional Stainless-Steel Blades. Sharp and durable blades deliver clean, precise cuts while maintaining reliable performance over time.

Specifications

  • Material: ABS Plastic
  • Number of Blades: 1
  • Gender: Men's
  • Speed Settings: High/Low
  • Product Feature: Comfortable Grip and Ergonomics Design
  • Package Includes: 1 x Hair Trimmer
  • Voltage: 220 Volts
  • Watts: 80 Watt

Looking after it

Charge it fully before the first use and it will hold that charge far longer over its life. Rinse only the parts the manual says are washable, and oil the blades every few cuts.
